note: Greenhouse crops (Prompt 08, food part). Every number here is GAME BALANCE, not a NASA figure. Crop cycles are TIME-COMPRESSED: a few sols in the game stand for weeks to months on Earth. Growing plants in an ISS chamber does not prove that crops grow on Mars.

lettuce.name: Lettuce
lettuce.evidence: ISS analog: lettuce was grown in the Veggie chamber on the International Space Station (S11). That is space-station evidence, not proof that it grows on Mars.

tomato.name: Tomato
tomato.evidence: Plan, not yet grown on the ISS: the NASA page lists tomatoes as produce the team hopes to plant in future (S11); a flight plan names tomato (S13, search lead only). It is not proof that tomatoes grow on Mars.
tomato.evidence_short: plan, not yet grown on the ISS
